description: ATB-calc is the national laboratory's Python toolkit for processing Annual Technology Baseline electricity data. It contains levelised-cost-of-energy calculations, technology-data extraction and a PySAM-based debt-fraction calculator. Inputs are ATB Excel workbooks and technology selections; outputs include flat or pivoted CSV tables, metadata and calculated financial parameters. Coverage follows the U.S. technology assumptions and years in the selected ATB release, not a single fixed scenario. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that the full pipeline requires Microsoft Excel through xlwings and currently runs on macOS or Windows, with Linux support only proposed. These dependencies have separate licensing requirements. The toolkit can prepare consistent cost inputs for electricity-capacity simulations. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related planning model. The review did not download an ATB workbook or calculate any technology costs.
